categories.name: Property Theft & Burglary
categories.description: Unlawful taking of personal or commercial property without direct interpersonal violence.

categories.name: Road & Traffic Safety Incident
categories.description: Reported road traffic hazards, hit-and-run, reckless vehicular incidents, or severe transit disruptions.

categories.name: Public Disturbance & Affray
categories.description: Disorderly conduct, localized brawl, or disturbance of public peace in public spaces.

categories.name: Substance & Contraband Offense
categories.description: Reported seizure or illegal trade of controlled illicit substances.

categories.name: Cyber & Financial Fraud
categories.description: Reported electronic banking fraud, online impersonation, or deceptive financial scams.

categories.name: Physical Assault & Hurt
categories.description: Physical interpersonal violence, simple or grievous hurt, or altercation involving weapons.

categories.name: Sexual Harassment & Offenses
categories.description: Reported sexual harassment, stalking, or assault. Under strict privacy policy, exact coordinates are NEVER published; aggregates only at Ward or District level.

categories.name: Domestic & Intimate Partner Violence
categories.description: Household cruelty, matrimonial dispute, or domestic violence. Strict suppression: zero coordinate pins, aggregated only.

categories.name: Offenses Against Children (POCSO)
categories.description: Incidents involving juveniles or minors. Strict suppression: zero coordinate pins, aggregated only at district level.
